description:
Start a recipe job immediately. Every enabled step runs automatically, including owner contact enrichment and Do Not Call checks by default; set includeContacts=false to skip contacts. Recipes (key: params besides location, maxCandidates, unknownPolicy, includeContacts):
- motivated_seller: off-market, owned a long time, high estimated equity (minTenureYears, minEquityPercent)
- absentee_owner: owner lives elsewhere, usually landlords (minTenureYears)
- pre_foreclosure: recent default or foreclosure filing with equity left (withinDays, minEquityPercent)
- free_and_clear: owned outright or nearly paid off (maxLtvPercent)
- vacant_property: reported vacant
- entity_owned: owned by an LLC, corporation or trust; includeContacts finds the people behind it (entityTypes, minTenureYears)
- neighbor_farming: every home within radiusMiles (default 0.25) of one property, with owner names, owner mailing address and estimated loan balance; location must include street plus state or ZIP; includeContacts adds phones and emails (radiusMiles)
Uses data credits as lookups complete. No separate approval or confirm flag is required to run the recipe. A job_id starts a legacy job that is still awaiting approval.
Poll with spur_get_data_job. Matched items are always saved to the user's properties when the job finishes (free), and also added to save_to_list_id when given; unknown items are saved to unknown_list_id only when given.

confirm.description: Legacy compatibility flag; recipes run without this flag.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse for retries of the same job to avoid duplicate execution

street.description: Street line, e.g. "100 Example Ave". Required for neighbor_farming.

params.description: Recipe parameters, e.g. minTenureYears, minEquityPercent, withinDays, maxLtvPercent, entityTypes, radiusMiles, maxCandidates, includeContacts

name: spur_run_data_job
title: Run a Data Search job
